newsitem.title: USA: Capstone Capital sets investment plan.
newsitem.headline: Capstone Capital sets investment plan.

text.p: Capstone Capital Corp said Thursday it has $31.8 million in new investments or commitments to invest in healthcare facilities.
The new investments include $9.6 million in equity and mortgage investments in four existing healthcare facilities, it said.
The commitments to invest include $22.2 million in equity and mortgage investments for 11 healthcare facilities now under development.

As part of the $9.6 million in new investments, the company is spending $4.3 million to acquire two assisted-living facilities in South Carolina and Florida. Those two facilities are operated by Integrated Living Communities Inc under a long-term lease.

It also is making $5.3 million in mortgage financing for a skilled nursing facility in Tennessee and an assisted-living facility in California. The two facilities are operated by privately held healthcare companies.
The $22.2 million in commitments to invest include $14.9 million in equity investments in four assisted-living facilities in North Carolina, Ohio and Pennsylvania.
It also plans to invest $7.3 million in mortgage financing for six assisted-living facilities and one skilled nursing facility in Florida, North Carolina, Pennsylvania and Alabama.
Those facilities are to be operated by privately held healthcare companies.
